description: Compile explicit portable VMD scenes, render native structures/trajectories/scalar fields, or create an independent offline 3Dmol inspection bundle without local VMD.

limits.native_render_requires: A separately licensed installed VMD executable and a compatible VMD Figure Studio Python runtime.
limits.scene_contract: Inline declarative spec only. Every structure, topology, trajectory and scalar-field input is an explicit absolute inputs[].path or coordinator artifact reference. Scene JSON filenames are not accepted.
limits.without_vmd: compile succeeds with compiled_unrendered; render is blocked while retaining a verified portable scene; viewer creates an independent 3Dmol preview and does not imply native VMD rendering.
limits.scientific_boundary: Technical completion never establishes electronic-structure validity, force-field validity, visual approval, browser WebGL acceptance or publication acceptance. Preserve scalar units, signs, frame choices and scientific provenance.

spec.description: Inline native VMD Figure Studio scene object. Use explicit source paths/artifact references in inputs[].path; keep original scalar units and atom ordering.

timeout_seconds.description: Further capped by the coordinator stage deadline.

spec.description: Inline native VMD Figure Studio scene with all dependencies explicit. Local VMD required for native rasters; unavailable VMD retains a compiled bundle and blocks rendering.

timeout_seconds.description: Further capped by the coordinator stage deadline.

input.description: Explicit coordinator-resolved coordinates or artifact reference; binary trajectories require an explicit coordinate conversion before this operation.

path.description: Explicit previously aligned field path or coordinator artifact reference.
